stack.title: Motion
stack.summary: Primary engine for product UI transitions: tabs, sheets, drawers, quick actions, reordering, loading, and page changes.
stack.rule: Use for behavior that explains structure or state. Respect reduced motion through tokenized alternatives.

stack.title: dotLottie
stack.summary: Animation format and player for onboarding, success, empty states, OTP, biometric, and route moments.
stack.rule: Use sparingly for teaching or emotional clarity. Never make task completion depend on the animation.

stack.title: GSAP
stack.summary: Reserved for immersive documentation demos, scroll choreography, complex SVG studies, and premium storytelling.
stack.rule: Optional, not part of the default product runtime. Requires explicit performance and accessibility review.

stack.title: Material Symbols
stack.summary: Base icon library for actions, navigation, status, vehicles, fuel, stations, maps, cards, and permissions.
stack.rule: Use as raw material, not as Material Design. Every icon gets a semantic role and accessible name policy.

stack.title: Apache ECharts
stack.summary: Dashboard visualization engine for KPI drilldowns, fuel, maintenance, EV, toll, fleet, and finance analytics.
stack.rule: Charts must include titles, descriptions, keyboard reachable summaries, color-safe palettes, and empty states.

stack.title: MapLibre GL or Mapbox
stack.summary: Map engine for nearby stations, clusters, route preview, distance, ETA, and layer control.
stack.rule: Choose MapLibre when open licensing matters; choose Mapbox when managed services and routing APIs are required.

stack.title: Edenred + Ubuntu
stack.summary: Edenred Black handles display, titles, and numerals. Ubuntu handles body, UI, captions, subtitles, tables, and code.
stack.rule: Self-host fonts when productized. Never replace titles with generic SaaS typography.
